intended_use: Detecting and classifying road damage (longitudinal, transverse and alligator cracks, potholes) in road images. Exact deployment context: TO CONFIRM with the team.
limitations: D10 has only 68 boxes in the whole dataset (8 in test); D10 metrics are unreliable.
Other RDD2022 damage types in the images were not labelled and act as background.
Test split comes from the original RDD2022 India training data; performance on other regions or cameras is unknown.
Only four near-duplicate pairs were controlled across splits; some leakage may remain.
About half of ground-truth boxes are missed at conf 0.25 / IoU 0.5; small, faint and thin damage is missed most.
Box granularity differs from the annotations (one large box vs several small ones), which lowers IoU-based scores.
